name: Furlbrow's Pocket Watch
summary: In Westfall, Farmer Furlbrow searches for the pocket watch he lost when Defias bandits drove him from home. Verna’s father gave it to him on their wedding day.

sections.title: A Keepsake in the Ruins
sections.body:
Defias bandits drove Farmer Furlbrow and Verna from their home at the Furlbrow Pumpkin Patch in the night. In their flight, he left the watch in a wardrobe in the overrun farmhouse. Benny Blaanco and his cutthroats keep watch nearby.

The couple now camps along the road. The watch is one of the few pieces of their former life the outlaws have not ruined.

faq.q: Why is the pocket watch so important to Farmer Furlbrow?
aliases: why does furlbrow want his watch
faq.answer: Verna’s father gave the watch to Farmer Furlbrow on their wedding day. After the Defias Brotherhood took their land, home, and livelihood, it remains the couple’s last deeply sentimental possession.

faq.q: Where is the pocket watch kept?
faq.answer: The watch lies in a wardrobe in the Furlbrow farmhouse, among the pumpkin fields west of the main road where the Furlbrows are stranded.
The Defias Brotherhood has taken over the farmhouse. Benny Blaanco and his cohort loiter near the wardrobe.

faq.q: Did the Defias steal the watch directly?
faq.answer: The Defias did not steal the watch directly. The Furlbrows fled in a panic when the bandits raided the pumpkin patch, and Farmer Furlbrow forgot to pack it. It remained in their bedroom wardrobe as the farm was overrun.

angles.text: Helping the Furlbrows recover their heirloom shows how completely the Stormwind crown has failed to protect Westfall’s hard-working farmers from organized banditry.
